sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽयमद्य पापात्मा मम दृष्टिपथं गतः ।अद्य क्रोधं विमोक्ष्यामि सीताहरणसम्भवम् ।। ६.५९.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā 'yamadya pāpātmā mama dṛṣṭipathaṁ gataḥ ।adya krodhaṁ vimokṣyāmi sītāharaṇasambhavam ।। 6.59.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "By his good luck, this sinful one has come under my sight. I will give vent to my wrath born of Sita's abduction."
